details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:1053-1061 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `test_skip_step_exhausted_redispatches_review_once` asserts no POST to `repos/o/r/issues/42/comments`, but `scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:479-496` posts the exhaustion comment after labelling, so the test fails in CI run 40844129836.
  WHY: The failure turns the tests-hooks-and-orchestrator job and the `lint` aggregate red. Reviewers differ on the cause: Sonnet and Luna say the test premise is wrong, while Gemini, MiniMax and GLM say the wrapper should signal the skip path so the pass suppresses the comment. Severity is BLOCKER in all five.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_deterministic_skip_security_pass.sh:152-161 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The wrapper invokes the pass in gate mode without a skip-path caller signal, and `scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:486-496` (also 520-528, 533-542) has no guard to suppress the exhaustion comment POSTs.
  WHY: The comment is posted although `agents.d/8333-skip-path-security-pass.md` and the wrapper header say there is no marker comment. Severity is BLOCKER (MiniMax), MAJOR (Gemini, GLM). Sonnet and Luna disagree on the root cause (see the first finding).
- tests/test_review_autofix_step_scripts_contract.py:189-193 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `test_skip_merge_job_step_scripts_come_only_from_verified_freshness_checkout` is defined after `if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())`, so it never runs when `.github/workflows/ci.yml:1660` runs the file as a script.
  WHY: Regressions in the skip job's sparse checkout, env wiring and step order go unnoticed. Severity is MAJOR in four reviews and NIT in Luna's.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:734 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The "Withdraw stale auto-merge and publish head-gate status" step, through `scripts/review_head_gate.sh:97-98`, posts `ai-review/head-gate` as `success` when `DETERMINISTIC_SKIP=true`, which now includes heads whose security audit is pending, has findings or is exhausted.
  WHY: The green status gives a merge-ready signal before the audit completes. Severity is BLOCKER (Luna), MAJOR (Sonnet, Gemini, GLM) and NIT (MiniMax, as a task gap). Sonnet notes that auto-merge enrollment stays gated on `hold=false`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1140-1148 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The security-pass steps are gated on `needs.gate.outputs.det_skip_security_pass == 'true'`, so an unset output silently skips the audit.
  WHY: Gemini calls this a fail-open that violates the mandatory-audit requirement. MiniMax rates it NIT, because the README documents unset as `false` and the gate then suppresses the skip. Severity is MAJOR (Gemini) and NIT (MiniMax); the highest is used.
- README.md:231 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED` row still says eligible PRs bypass the deterministic skip, which is stale when `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS` is on (the default).
  WHY: Operators get the wrong routing description; there is no runtime effect.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:829-831 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `gate_freshness_sync_fast_path` comment says the skip job runs no single-issue security pass, which is stale when the new switch is on.
  WHY: The comment contradicts the new behaviour and misleads readers.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_deterministic_skip_security_pass.sh:104-182 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `mktemp -d` work directory is removed only on the success path, so the `pr_payload_mismatch`, output-write and checkout early returns leak it.
  WHY: This leaves small files under RUNNER_TEMP until the job ends. It is hardening only (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1). Sonnet rates it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Tests: extend `tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py` and the gate tests that cover `AUTOFIX_GATE_DET_SKIP_SUPPRESSED`; with the switch `false`, gate output and job routing are byte-identical to today.
  expected_change_site: A behavioural run of the real `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh` with the switch true, false and unset, using the `_run_gate` harnesses in tests/test_review_autofix_claude_fixer_mode.py and tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py.
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Gate coverage is only string-position assertions (tests/test_pr_base_freshness_gate.py:988-998, `test_gate_switch_off_keeps_todays_suppression_and_outputs`), no test runs the gate to check `det_skip_security_pass=true`, the PR snapshot shape, `deterministic_skip=false` with `ai:security-pass-failed`, or the absent outputs when the switch is off.
- requirement: On `exhausted=true` on the skip path, hand off as the codex-agent path does (review-blocked judge in security-exhaustion mode) and do not merge; the agents.d contract says no marker comment, because the `ai:security-pass-failed` label is the routing signal.
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_autofix_step_deterministic_skip_security_pass.sh and scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh (comment POSTs at lines 486-496, 520-528, 533-542)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The wrapper passes no skip-path caller signal and the pass script has no skip-aware code path, so `scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:495` posts the comment unconditionally and the CI test fails. Gemini's variant instead says the wrapper does not verify that the label was applied before re-dispatch. Sonnet disputes the label claim, saying the pass labels the PR before the skip job re-dispatches review.
- requirement: Issue #8333: an eligible PR must not auto-merge, or get merge-ready labels, without a clean `status=clean` marker for its current head.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:723-748 and scripts/review_head_gate.sh:97-98
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: With `DETERMINISTIC_SKIP=true` and `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS=true`, `ai-review/head-gate` is posted as `success` ("deterministic skip evaluated this head") before the security pass runs, and `REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_STATUS_ENABLED` defaults to `true`.
- requirement: review_autofix.yml must stay under the 480,000-byte guard and keep tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py green.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR context does not show whether the size test still passes after the two new steps. Sonnet says the guard is present in the diff and does not report it.
- requirement: Inline comments and docs in the modified code must reflect the new behaviour (README `AUTOFIX_SKIP_DOC_ONLY` and `SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED` rows).
  expected_change_site: README.md:231 and scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:829-831
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The README row at line 231 and the comment at lines 829-831 still describe the old routing. The `AUTOFIX_SKIP_DOC_ONLY` row at line 178 was updated.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:734 (also scripts/review_head_gate.sh:97-98) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The gate posts `ai-review/head-gate` as `success` for any `deterministic_skip=true` head, including heads not yet audited.
  WHY: A PR with a pending or failed audit shows a green status without the clean marker. Auto-merge enrollment stays gated on `hold=false`, so the impact is lower than a direct bypass.
- tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:1061 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The assertion that no comment is posted is wrong, because `scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh` lines 479-496 post the exhaustion comment after labelling.
  WHY: CI run 40844129836 shows `1 failed, 154 passed`, so `lint` is red. The skip script behaves correctly; the fix is to assert on the dispatch and label calls and allow the pass's own comment, and to correct the "no marker comment" wording in agents.d/8333-skip-path-security-pass.md, the changelog and the wrapper header. No suppression knob is recommended.
- tests/test_review_autofix_step_scripts_contract.py:189-193 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `test_skip_merge_job_step_scripts_come_only_from_verified_freshness_checkout` is defined after the `__main__` guard, so it never runs under `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 1660.
  WHY: Regressions in the skip job's sparse checkout, env wiring and step order go unnoticed. Moving it above the guard, and into `main()`'s list if it enumerates tests, fixes this.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_deterministic_skip_security_pass.sh (`mktemp -d` and early `return 1` paths) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The temp directory leaks on the `pr_payload_mismatch` and output-write failure returns.
  WHY: Only a few small files remain under RUNNER_TEMP on an ephemeral runner (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
- README.md (`SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED` row) and scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:829-831 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The README row and the `gate_freshness_sync_fast_path` comment still say eligible PRs bypass the skip job, or that it runs no security pass.
  WHY: These are stale when `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS` is on (the default); there is no runtime effect.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Tests: extend `tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py` and the gate tests that cover `AUTOFIX_GATE_DET_SKIP_SUPPRESSED`", and "With the new switch `false`, gate output and job routing are byte-identical to today."
  Expected change site: a behavioural run of the real `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh` with the switch true, false and unset, extending `_run_gate` in tests/test_review_autofix_claude_fixer_mode.py and tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py
  Evidence of absence: The gate changes are covered only by text-position assertions (tests/test_pr_base_freshness_gate.py lines 988-998 and `test_gate_switch_off_keeps_todays_suppression_and_outputs`), so the byte-identical switch-off claim is not verified by execution.
  severity=NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
